title: Navigate the built docs through a lazily loaded Pagefind dialog

hashes.pagefind_version: 1.5.2 (pinned; resolved through pnpm dlx — no package.json or lockfile change)

build.command: pnpm registry:build && pnpm gallery:manifest && pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build

index.observed: fail-closed destination check passes (56 items + 7 docs); real Pagefind CLI indexes 63 pages, 7269 words; pagefind-entry.json reports 63 pages across 1 language.

red.observed: 10/15 cases fail at the missing search surface (locator('[data-search-slot] button') never resolves; no dialog, no Pagefind activation); 5/5 chromium-nojs cases pass because the no-JavaScript surface contract already holds pre-implementation.

green.observed: ALL 8 failures are the single pinned /components/streamdown destination leg ('could not activate /components/streamdown/; results were [/docs/owns-vs-does-not-own/, /docs/installation/]' or 'a result for /components/streamdown/ must exist'). Every other contracted behavior passes within those cases before the pinned leg and outright in the 7 passing cases: 0 pre-activation Pagefind requests across browse/hover/soft-nav; dialog open within 300ms (island in-page clock and transport clock); same-origin pagefind.js loads exactly once; real index chunks load with the first query; unchanged reopen adds 0 requests; initialization survives ClientRouter soft navigation with one shortcut opening exactly one dialog; grouped components/ui/lib/pages results with matching aria-live counts; ArrowDown/Up selection changes; Escape restores invoker focus; genuine empty state and recovery; literal HTML-shaped query creates zero nodes/attributes; real offline failure produces exactly one visible error plus captured requestfailed; five-item/three-doc destination tours return HTTP 200 with source-matching titles.

supplementary_gates.search_index_vitest: pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-05-orient-search/search-index.test.ts — 5/5 pass (model coverage 56+7; real indexer exit 0; props/verdict/hidden-engine-panel text inside data-pagefind-body regions; fail-closed scratch removal names /components/conversation)
supplementary_gates.island_budget_vitest: pnpm exec vitest run tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/island-budget.test.ts — 3/3 pass (exactly five customElements.define incl. rnr-search-dialog; zero framework imports; theme/tab contracts preserved)
supplementary_gates.typecheck: pnpm typecheck — exit 0 (root tsc covers scripts/ and tests/, not Astro templates)
supplementary_gates.lint: ./node_modules/@biomejs/biome/bin/biome ci . — exit 0 (4 pre-existing warnings in untouched files); pnpm lint script dies locally (biome OOM), binary used directly

acceptance.AC-1: partially proven: boundary (renderMarkdown, dev client), prop (nearBottomThreshold), verdict ('runs in Expo Go' searchable; distinctive emitted phrase finds Conversation), direct pointer click of a rendered result, categories components/ui/lib/pages all observed; four of five item destinations and all three doc destinations return HTTP 200 with matching titles through real searches. NOT proven: the /components/streamdown destination leg — no such destination exists in the candidate.
acceptance.AC-2: proven (chromium-desktop + chromium-mobile): 0 pre-activation requests, <=300ms open, single same-origin module request, unchanged reopen adds 0 requests, initialization survives soft navigation.
acceptance.AC-3: partially proven: dialog count/focus/aria-live match, arrow selection, Escape invoker-focus restoration, shortcut reopen, Enter-through-island navigation all pass; no-JavaScript surface (working links, zero Pagefind requests, hidden trigger) passes on chromium-nojs. NOT proven: the Enter leg to /components/streamdown.
acceptance.AC-4: partially proven: run-specific no-match empty state and recovery, literal HTML-shaped query creates zero DOM, real offline failure (context.setOffline) yields exactly one visible error plus captured requestfailed with <=300ms open and invoker focus restored, fresh online search works. NOT proven: the final online follow to /components/streamdown.

known_blockers.blocker: /components/streamdown does not exist in the built candidate (no streamdown registry item among the 56; verified 404 by dist inspection, curl, and the real index — searching 'streamdown' returns only /docs/owns-vs-does-not-own/ and /docs/installation/).
known_blockers.decision_owner: human (wave-4 ruling: 'the two honest options — create a docs-owned destination vs amend three tasks' ACs plus gate steps human-flows.json:730,742 — change what the gate proves. Do not choose.')
known_blockers.unblocks: ORI-AST-004 streamdown legs (AC-1/2/3/4), ORI-VIS-003 AC-2, ORI-AST-010 gate steps, FLOW-SHELL-07/08 journey legs

known_blockers.blocker: run order hazard: any astro build (including island-budget.test.ts's SHELL-003 chain) wipes dist/pagefind; the task-owned indexer must run after the last build before any preview-backed lane. CI owns this ordering; locally the final gate order is island-budget -> search-index -> playwright.
